streaming_semantics: Trainer.run consumes batches directly with a for-loop over the supplied Iterable.
The loop stops once max_steps is reached instead of materializing unused batches.
The method does not require Sequence semantics, len(), indexing, list(), tuple(), or sorted() materialization of batches.
A one-shot generator therefore satisfies the method's data-source contract.
